decisions.reason: The selected Hero V geometry exemplifies the existing elegant, confident, restrained, and harmonious visual tone but does not change the brand-expression requirement.
The source refines only the Hero V arms and does not resume or alter the deferred É-accent requirement; its existing derivation from the eventual Hero V geometry remains valid unchanged.
The source selects Hero V arm geometry but does not establish a new form for the second V; its existing requirement to derive from the Hero V remains valid unchanged.
The source concerns the Hero V specifically and does not resume or modify the deferred construction of the remaining proprietary wordmark letterforms.
No material or color decision is made; the deferred champagne-gold treatment and its sequencing after geometry resolution remain unchanged.
The reference to harmony within the complete letter concerns the Hero V itself, not the deferred composition, kerning, or rhythm of the complete wordmark.
The source changes the selected arms and the left arm's lean but does not specify a new terminal construction or replace the existing non-decorative terminal principles.
Refining the Hero V geometry does not change the established decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
The Hero V geometry decision does not change the requirement to provide final production-ready artwork.
